payload.title: Adopt a type-specific Universal Project Adapter Standard while keeping native configuration authoritative
payload.context: The bootstrap adapter was a provisional generic envelope payload. Task 0000000000003 formalizes adapter semantics without redesigning the canonical foundation meta-model.
payload.problem: The foundation needs a standard representation of implementation-environment facts that distinguishes detection, declaration and verification and supports polyglot/workspace projects without becoming a second build system.
considered_options: keep the provisional free-form adapter payload
embed adapter semantics into the canonical foundation meta-model
add a type-specific adapter schema within the existing foundation schema directory and preserve the stable adapter path/id
payload.rationale: This preserves the universal meta-model, keeps adapter semantics extensible, makes validation explicit, and avoids duplicating native build/package/deployment configuration.
consequences: The stable .foundation/adapter.json path and project-adapter id are preserved.
The adapter object version advances to 2.0.0 while the Project Adapter Standard begins at 1.0.0.
Native project files remain authoritative and are referenced rather than copied.
Historical task 0000000000001 and 0000000000002 records are not rewritten.
payload.compatibility_impact: The provisional adapter payload changes shape prospectively, but stable adapter path/id remain. Historical evidence and the canonical meta-model remain unchanged.
payload.migration_impact: Migrate only the current mutable .foundation/adapter.json to the standard format; do not rewrite historical reports or evidence.
